## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- MachiningVisionDiagnosticEngine — chip diagnostics
- blue short-C chip = ideal roughing state → no adjustments, auto-approves
- burnt black chips → critical, reduce SFM 15% + boost coolant 20%, requires confirmation
- powder/dust chips (too thin) → increase feed 20%, critical severity
- welded BUE chip → increase SFM 25%, warning severity
- MachiningVisionDiagnosticEngine — part diagnostics
